description: I interviewed at a Series B fintech, maybe 300 people, for a senior backend role. Recruiter screen, then a coding round in Go, then a system design session, then a take-home on rate limiting which we reviewed in a follow-up call, then a final panel with two engineers and the VP. Took about five weeks. They went with someone internal in the end.

expect.note: take-home + its review call is ONE round
